premises.text: Most people cannot freely edit the web without hiring developers or living inside rigid templates
premises.evidence_span: if you wanted to make even the slightest change to a page on the Web, like moving something one inch to the right, you better be willing to call a developer or agency

premises.text: PageCloud gives browser-based freeform editing—drag media and widgets, paste from design tools, go live instantly—including mobile reflow and copy-from-page rebuilds
premises.evidence_span: everyone with a web browser gets complete creative freedom, not just to surf the web or to fill in the blanks, but to really create it

premises.text: Patent-pending deep technology differentiates the editable rebuild and creative-control experience
premises.evidence_span: There's some deep technology at work here. One of PageCloud's 18 patent-pending inventions

premises.text: Sites can be preordered at a promotional annual price for early public release
premises.evidence_span: you're going to get an amazing price of just $75 for the year for your site

value.text: Anyone can create and update live web pages with unrestricted creative control
value.evidence_span: This is content creation and manipulation without restriction

causal_links.evidence_span: There's a part of the internet that's fundamentally broken
There's no other platform on the planet that gives you this creative freedom
preorder today and become one of the first people to truly experience the web the way it was always meant to be
